name: What is the typical cost range for building an outdoor fireplace in Los Angeles?
description: Outdoor fireplace costs in Los Angeles range from $5,000 for basic units to over $30,000 for custom designs, depending on materials and complexity.

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for building an outdoor fireplace in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of an outdoor fireplace in the Los Angeles area varies significantly based on factors such as materials, size, design complexity, and any necessary site preparation. Basic, pre-fabricated units can start from $5,000 to $10,000. Custom-built fireplaces using high-end materials like natural stone, stucco, or brick, with integrated features or elaborate designs, typically range from $15,000 to $30,000 or more. Additional costs may include gas line installation, electrical work for lighting, and landscaping modifications. A detailed estimate requires an on-site consultation to assess your specific needs and design preferences.
